_comment0: SLAMTEC RPLIDAR A1M8. Isaac ships a SLAMTEC profile but it is the S2E, which is a different sensor: 30 m range and 10 Hz against the A1M8's 12 m and 5.5 Hz. Using it would have quietly given this robot a lidar it does not own.
_comment1: Range, scan rate and sample rate are the A1M8 datasheet figures. reportRateBaseHz 8000 at scanRateBaseHz 5.5 gives ~1454 samples/rev, i.e. ~0.25 deg, which is what the sample duration implies; SLAMTEC's headline '<=1 deg angular resolution' is the conservative spec rather than the achieved one.
_comment2: The optical and error terms (reflectance, pulse time, azimuth/elevation error) are NOT in the A1M8 datasheet and are carried over from Isaac's S2E profile. They are plausible for a 905 nm class triangulation scanner but they are not measured, so treat returns as geometry rather than photometry.
_comment3: The A1M8 emitter is 785 nm, not the S2E's 905 nm.
name: RPLIDAR A1M8
